name: TickM
description: Time tracking that works. Every billable minute, captured from the AI apps you already live in — so the hours make it to the invoice without another tab, another tool, or another forgotten entry.

_published_faq.name: How do I add TickM to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add TickM to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.tickm.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the TickM MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: TickM provides these MCP tools: add_time_entry, create_client, create_project, delete_time_entry, edit_client, edit_project, edit_time_entry, list_projects, and search_time_entries.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to TickM?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to TickM in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
TickM requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
TickM is developed by Saberin Software. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
